rationale.overall: A and B are visually near-identical in composition, palette, slab pose, curl, ground split, and glow, and both sit the same distance from the REFERENCE’s volumetric stone-and-frosted-loop read.
rationale.material: Both render a smooth gradient-shaded dark slab with a pale loop and orange underglow, equally short of the REFERENCE’s gritty stone microtexture, light-transmitting ribbon, and soft long contact shadow.
rationale.silhouette: The diagonal slab, upper-left curl, and ground split occupy the same positions and proportions in both takes, with no silhouette difference that favors either.
rationale.smallsize: At 128, 32, and 16px both collapse to the same dark diagonal bar with an orange underline on a split light ground, holding the read equally and losing the curl equally.
